label: ANALYSIS_PLAN A12.3 pre-registered (a12_3_impact.json, a12_3_flagged_rows.csv); a12_3_by_wall_side.json is exploratory, post hoc
a12_3_impact.json: fixed receiver (5cb272b) vs frozen held-out run: ho_02 and ho_10, records 0-3, 5 sigma, 2 worlds, 6 methods (480 rows); decision and S_c1 differences, every differing non-timing column
a12_3_flagged_rows.csv: rows with a decision difference or |dS_c1|/|S_c1| >= 1e-3
a12_3_by_wall_side.json: the same differences split by whether the planned wall side flipped; the 3 decision flips
a2_s_difference.csv: A-2: paired S_c1 difference (fixed - frozen) per method and hypothesis, split by wall side unchanged/flipped
a2_decomposition.csv: A-2: target S ratio decomposed into net_wall / net_direct / r_dt (side unchanged), with one-sample t-test
a2_summary.json: A-2: interpretation; the shift is consistent with gate-discretization noise, not systematic
